items.title: Keep Replies catch-up retryable
items.detail: If a later page fails while Tuner checks read positions or searches for replies, it keeps the results it can use. An unfinished reply search stays eligible for catch-up on the next reconnect.

items.title: Compatibility
items.detail: Compatible with Tightbeam: none verified. This build was not verified against Tightbeam 0.1.16 (build 4304), Tightbeam 0.1.15 (build 4082), or Chat v0.1.104. No version-specific test evidence is tied to this build.
